<thought>The isotopic pattern shows a monoisotopic peak at 134.11 with decreasing peaks at +1, +2, +3, etc., matching the expected carbon 13C distribution for roughly 10 carbons. No significant M+2 peak characteristic of Cl, Br, S, etc., is present, so only carbon can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
